tasks.title: Fix narration startup retry loop (TDD)
tasks.notes: Refactored startNarrationServer to accept optional deps.checkHealth and deps.sleep for testability. Retry loop polls up to 10 times with 1s intervals. Added 3 new tests: retry-succeeds-on-Nth, early-exit-on-first-success, throws-after-all-retries. All 15 narration tests pass. Existing tests updated to inject noopSleep to avoid real timeouts.

tasks.title: Guard auto-review feedback read (TDD)
tasks.description:
Bug: `runAutoReview()` in `src/commands/plan.ts` (~line 714) does `readFileSync` on `.ralph/review-feedback.md` without guarding for existence. If the reviewer agent fails or writes nothing, the read throws ENOENT and crashes the plan command.

Fix (TDD — write tests first):

1. In `test/commands/plan.test.ts`, add a test for the missing-file scenario:
   - Mock/inject a `readFileFn` that throws ENOENT (or use the `deps` injection pattern already in `runAutoReview`)
   - Verify the function logs a warning containing "Reviewer did not produce feedback" instead of crashing
   - Verify it returns a NEEDS_WORK result with an explanatory summary

2. In `src/commands/plan.ts` `runAutoReview()`, before line 714 (`const feedbackContent = doReadFile(feedbackPath, 'utf8');`), add an existence check. The function already has `doReadFile` injected via `deps`. Add a corresponding `existsSyncFn` to the deps interface (defaulting to `fs.existsSync`). If the file doesn't exist:
   - Log a warning: `log('Reviewer did not produce feedback file; treating as NEEDS_WORK');`
   - Set `lastResult = { dimensions: [], verdict: 'NEEDS_WORK', summary: 'Reviewer did not produce feedback file' };`
   - `continue` to next pass (or fall through if last iteration)

3. Run `bun test test/commands/plan.test.ts` to confirm all tests pass.

tasks.title: Verify build and full test suite
tasks.description:
Run the full test suite and build to confirm both bug fixes integrate cleanly.

1. Run `bun test` — all tests must pass.
2. Run `bun run build` — must produce `dist/ralph` without errors.
3. If anything fails, diagnose and fix the issue.
